name: module-preloaded-behind-an-unread-launcher
description: A script command behind a launcher option, here env --frobnicate, still names its files and packages: the file its --require=./setup.ts preloads and what only that file keeps live are held and not reported, the package its --require never-loaded preloads is used, and the manifest is noted. A file and a package no command names are still reported.
